C for the petitioner is on record.
He has filed a memo dated 08.08.2024 seeking withdrawal of the petition.
Therefore, the memo is taken on record.
In terms of the said memo, the petition is dismissed as withdrawn.
Learned HCGP is directed to accept the notice in respect of Respondent/State.
Accordingly, the petition is disposed of.
